use anchor_lang::prelude::*;

#[error_code]
pub enum TreasuryError {
    WrongState = 0,
    Unauthorized = 1,
    LimitExceeded = 2,
    InvalidAmount = 3,
    MathOverflow = 4,
    MathUnderflow = 5,
    InvalidLifecycle = 6,
}

// ---- GENERATED BY QEDGEN — DO NOT EDIT — regenerated from .qedspec ----
//! Per-handler guard checks derived from the `.qedspec`.
//! Called from user-owned `instructions/<name>::handler` before
//! business logic; keep guard logic here, policy-free logic there.

#![allow(
    unused_variables,
    unused_imports,
    dead_code,
    clippy::too_many_arguments
)]

use crate::errors::*;
use crate::state::*;
use crate::*;
use anchor_lang::prelude::*;

/// Guards for `initialize`.  
/// Generated from the `requires` clauses of the spec handler block.
pub fn initialize<'info>(ctx: &mut Initialize<'info>, limit: u64) -> Result<()> {
    // No guards declared in spec — nothing to check.
    Ok(())
}

/// Guards for `spend`.  
/// Generated from the `requires` clauses of the spec handler block.
pub fn spend<'info>(ctx: &mut Spend<'info>, amount: u64) -> Result<()> {
    // lifecycle: require inner == Active
    if !matches!(ctx.treasury.inner, TreasuryAccountInner::Active { .. }) {
        return Err(crate::errors::TreasuryError::InvalidLifecycle.into());
    }
    // requires: registry_cfg.operator = operator.pubkey
    if !((*ctx.registry_cfg.inner.operator()) == ctx.operator.key()) {
        return Err(TreasuryError::Unauthorized.into());
    }
    // requires: amount > 0
    if !(amount > 0) {
        return Err(TreasuryError::InvalidAmount.into());
    }
    // requires: amount ≤ s.spend_limit
    if !(amount <= (*ctx.treasury.inner.spend_limit())) {
        return Err(TreasuryError::LimitExceeded.into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

// ---- END GENERATED ----

//! v2.29 Slice H mirror of `Registry`'s account types
//! (sourced from dep `registry`).
//!
//! Hand-editing is unsafe: every `qedgen codegen` regenerates
//! this file from the imported `.qedspec`'s `type` declarations.
//! To change a field, change the imported spec and re-resolve.

use anchor_lang::prelude::*;

#[account]
pub struct State {
    pub inner: StateInner,
}

/// Variant-payload state for `State` (mirrored from `registry`).
#[derive(AnchorSerialize, AnchorDeserialize, InitSpace, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum StateInner {
    Draft { operator: Pubkey },
    Live { operator: Pubkey, epoch: u64 },
}

impl StateInner {
    /// v2.29 Slice H accessor for `epoch`. Panics on variants
    /// that don't carry the field — the per-handler lifecycle
    /// check at the top of each `crate::guards::*` fn prevents
    /// the panic arm from being reached at runtime.
    pub fn epoch(&self) -> &u64 {
        match self {
            Self::Live { epoch, .. } => epoch,
            _ => panic!("StateInner::epoch() called on a variant without `epoch`"),
        }
    }
    /// v2.29 Slice H accessor for `operator`. Panics on variants
    /// that don't carry the field — the per-handler lifecycle
    /// check at the top of each `crate::guards::*` fn prevents
    /// the panic arm from being reached at runtime.
    pub fn operator(&self) -> &Pubkey {
        match self {
            Self::Draft { operator, .. } => operator,
            Self::Live { operator, .. } => operator,
        }
    }
}

--- src/instructions/initialize.rs ---
// User-owned. Regenerating the spec does NOT overwrite this file.
// Guard checks live in the sibling `crate::guards` module and ARE
// regenerated on every `qedgen codegen`. Drift between the spec
// handler block and the `spec_hash` below fires a compile_error!
// via the `#[qed(verified, ...)]` macro.

use crate::guards;
use crate::state::TreasuryAccountInner;
use crate::{Initialize, InitializeBumps};
use anchor_lang::prelude::*;
use qedgen_macros::qed;

impl<'info> Initialize<'info> {
    #[qed(
        verified,
        spec = "../treasury.qedspec",
        handler = "initialize",
        hash = "f99d3675468e4ef8",
        spec_hash = "69fbbc428ff1aaed"
    )]
    #[inline(always)]
    pub fn handler(&mut self, limit: u64, bumps: &InitializeBumps) -> Result<()> {
        guards::initialize(self, limit)?;
        let _ = bumps;
        self.treasury.inner = TreasuryAccountInner::Active {
            balance: 0,
            spend_limit: limit,
        };
        Ok(())
    }
}

--- src/instructions/spend.rs ---
// User-owned. Regenerating the spec does NOT overwrite this file.
// Guard checks live in the sibling `crate::guards` module and ARE
// regenerated on every `qedgen codegen`. Drift between the spec
// handler block and the `spec_hash` below fires a compile_error!
// via the `#[qed(verified, ...)]` macro.

use crate::errors::*;
use crate::guards;
use crate::state::TreasuryAccountInner;
use crate::Spend;
use anchor_lang::prelude::*;
use qedgen_macros::qed;

impl<'info> Spend<'info> {
    #[qed(
        verified,
        spec = "../treasury.qedspec",
        handler = "spend",
        hash = "817b48b530db3319",
        spec_hash = "965a1a29ef8be7d7"
    )]
    #[inline(always)]
    pub fn handler(&mut self, amount: u64) -> Result<()> {
        guards::spend(self, amount)?;
        match &mut self.treasury.inner {
            TreasuryAccountInner::Active { balance, .. } => {
                *balance = balance
                    .checked_sub(amount)
                    .ok_or(TreasuryError::MathUnderflow)?;
            }
            _ => return Err(TreasuryError::WrongState.into()),
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

// ---- GENERATED BY QEDGEN — DO NOT EDIT ---- spec-hash:8be50b49695ef397
#![allow(unexpected_cfgs)]

use anchor_lang::prelude::*;

pub mod errors;
pub mod guards;
pub mod imported;
mod instructions;
pub mod state;

declare_id!("11111111111111111111111111111111");

#[program]
pub mod treasury {
    use super::*;

    pub fn initialize(ctx: Context<Initialize>, limit: u64) -> Result<()> {
        ctx.accounts.handler(limit, &ctx.bumps)
    }

    pub fn spend(ctx: Context<Spend>, amount: u64) -> Result<()> {
        ctx.accounts.handler(amount)
    }
}

// `#[derive(Accounts)]` structs live at the crate root so the
// Anchor `#[program]` macro can resolve them via `crate::*`.
// The handler impl blocks live next to the (always-regenerated)
// guard module in `instructions/<name>.rs`.
use crate::state::*;

#[derive(Accounts)]
pub struct Initialize<'info> {
    #[account(mut)]
    pub payer: Signer<'info>,
    #[account(init, payer = payer, space = 8 + TreasuryAccount::INIT_SPACE, seeds = [b"treasury", payer.key().as_ref()], bump)]
    pub treasury: Account<'info, TreasuryAccount>,
}

#[derive(Accounts)]
pub struct Spend<'info> {
    pub operator: Signer<'info>,
    #[account(mut)]
    pub treasury: Account<'info, TreasuryAccount>,
    pub registry_cfg: Account<'info, crate::imported::Registry::State>,
}

// ---- GENERATED BY QEDGEN — DO NOT EDIT ---- spec-hash:5dd8003638485e32
use anchor_lang::prelude::*;

#[account]
#[derive(InitSpace)]
pub struct TreasuryAccount {
    pub inner: TreasuryAccountInner,
}

/// Variant-payload state for TreasuryAccount. The Anchor wrapper above
/// carries the account discriminator; this enum carries the
/// state-machine variant + per-variant payload fields.
#[derive(AnchorSerialize, AnchorDeserialize, InitSpace, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum TreasuryAccountInner {
    Uninitialized,
    Active { balance: u64, spend_limit: u64 },
}

impl TreasuryAccountInner {
    /// v2.29 Slice B accessor for `balance`. Panics on variants
    /// that don't carry the field — guarded against by the
    /// per-handler lifecycle check that fires before any
    /// `requires` emission in `crate::guards`.
    pub fn balance(&self) -> &u64 {
        match self {
            Self::Active { balance, .. } => balance,
            _ => panic!("TreasuryAccountInner::balance() called on a variant without `balance`"),
        }
    }
    /// v2.29 Slice B accessor for `spend_limit`. Panics on variants
    /// that don't carry the field — guarded against by the
    /// per-handler lifecycle check that fires before any
    /// `requires` emission in `crate::guards`.
    pub fn spend_limit(&self) -> &u64 {
        match self {
            Self::Active { spend_limit, .. } => spend_limit,
            _ => panic!(
                "TreasuryAccountInner::spend_limit() called on a variant without `spend_limit`"
            ),
        }
    }
}
